deliv.lead: {n} things, delivered once for {price}. {name} includes everything below.

how.title: From a free Snapshot to The Plan
how.1x: Send your business name, website or Instagram, email, city and industry. We prepare your free Snapshot and email it to you.
how.2x: If you want the full picture, The Plan is a one-time purchase. Reply to your Snapshot email and we take it from there.
how.3x: Your audit, fixes, first-screen mock, page titles, comparison and posts come together, with a 15-minute call. After 30 days we re-check and show your before and after score.
ind.title: Built for local businesses
ind.lead: Owner-run shops and studios that serve one city.
ind.1x: Menu highlights, seasonal specials and opening hours. The Snapshot checks whether people can order or ask a question from your first screen.
ind.2x: Services, team and booking. The Snapshot checks whether your site shows your services and an easy way to book.
ind.3x: Class schedules, coaches and memberships. The Snapshot checks whether a new member can find a class and book.
ind.4x: Dental, physio and similar. Posts cover your team, space, services, hours and booking.
ind.4note: No health or treatment claims, and no patient photos unless you supply written consent.
ind.5x: Cleaners, repair, trades and other local businesses. Posts cover what you do, where you work and how to book.

faq.title: Straight answers
faq.1q: What do you need from me?
faq.1a1: For the free Snapshot: your business name, website or Instagram, email, city and industry.
faq.1a2: For The Plan: your logo, brand colors if you have them, and your own photos. We don't use stock photos of strangers in your posts.
faq.2q: What do I do with the fixes?
faq.2a1: They are written out so you can paste them in, or hand them to whoever looks after your website. The posts are files for you to use. Nothing is published for you.
faq.3a1: No. The Plan is a single payment. There is no monthly charge.
faq.4a1: You own the posts and captions made for you in The Plan and can keep using them. [DRAFT: final wording comes from the terms of service.]
faq.5a1: No. Nobody can honestly promise that. The Snapshot shows where you stand and what to fix first, and The Plan gives you the fixes and posts written out. Results depend on your business, your market and what you do with them.
faq.6a1: The Plan is a one-time purchase. [DRAFT: refund terms are not final. The wording will be on the refund page before anyone is charged.]
faq.7q: What languages do you work in?
faq.8q: Where do the competitor numbers come from?
faq.8a1: From public sources only: your site and theirs, Google results and listings, and public Instagram profiles. When comparable nearby businesses are found, we compare you with businesses of a similar size near you, not with national chains. If we can't find comparable ones, we say so instead of guessing.
faq.9a1: We use them to prepare your Snapshot and email it to you. You can ask us to delete them any time at {email}. See the privacy page (DRAFT) for the details.

terms.intro: The terms for using crierstudio.com and for the Snapshot and The Plan.
terms.who.p: Crier Studio is run by <ph>[entity name]</ph> (the entity name is not final).
terms.offer.p1: Snapshot (free): three findings with proof from your own website or profile, one of the fixes written out in full, and three posts in your brand.
terms.offer.p2: The Plan (one-time purchase, {price} founding price for the first {n} businesses, then {regular}): a full audit of your website, search results and social profiles; your top three fixes written to paste in; a first-screen mock; rewritten page titles; a same-size competitor comparison when comparable nearby businesses are found; 20 posts with captions; a 15-minute call; and a re-check after 30 days with a before and after score.
terms.offer.p3: The Plan is a single payment, not a subscription. How payment is taken will be shown before you pay.
terms.nopromise.p: We do not promise more customers, more sales, a search ranking or any other result. What we deliver is the review, the written fixes, the mock, the titles, the comparison and the posts described above. What happens next depends on your business, your market and what you do with them.
terms.need.p: Accurate details, and only photos, logos and text you have the right to use. Nothing is published for you: you decide what to use.
terms.public.p: We review your site and profiles and, for comparisons, public information about similar businesses. If we cannot find comparable businesses we say so. Numbers come from public sources and can be incomplete or out of date.
terms.own.h: Ownership of what we make for you
terms.own.p: <ph>[DRAFT: you own the posts and captions made for you in The Plan and may keep using them. Final wording to be confirmed.]</ph>
terms.limits.p: <ph>[DRAFT: limitation of liability, governing law and how disputes are handled. To be completed before this takes effect.]</ph>
privacy.intro: What Crier Studio collects when you ask for a Snapshot on crierstudio.com, why, who sees it, how long it is kept, and how to have it deleted.
privacy.collect.p1: When you fill in the Snapshot form we collect what you type: your business name, your website or Instagram handle, your email address, your city and your industry. We also record that you ticked the box agreeing to the use below, and the time you did.
privacy.collect.p2: To limit abuse, the form's server briefly uses your connection's address to count requests. It is kept only as a scrambled value in memory for up to an hour and is not saved with your details. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies on this site.
privacy.why.p: To prepare your free Snapshot from your own website and public profiles, and to email it to the address you gave. If you later ask about The Plan, we use the same details to follow up on that. We do not email you anything you did not ask for, and we do not sell your details.
privacy.who.p: Crier Studio (<ph>[entity name]</ph>) and the people who prepare Snapshots for it. Your details are stored in Crier Studio's own records system, which is hosted with a service provider (Railway). This site is hosted on GitHub Pages and its domain is handled by Cloudflare; they may see ordinary visit data such as the address of your connection. We do not share your details with anyone else unless the law requires it. <ph>[DRAFT: list of providers to be checked before this takes effect]</ph>
privacy.keep.p: <ph>[DRAFT: proposed] We keep your details for up to 12 months after our last contact with you, then delete them.</ph> If you buy The Plan, we keep what we need for the purchase for as long as the law requires.
privacy.del.p: Email {email} from the address you used and ask us to delete your details. We will delete them and confirm. You can also ask what we hold about you, or ask us to correct it, at the same address.
privacy.changes.p: This is a draft. The final text will replace it before it takes effect, and the date above will change.
